`test/orders.js` is a small order-utility module, not a test file. It exports four functions:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price * qty` across line items.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: computes total divided by item count.
- `formatOrder(order)`: renders the order as text with a final total.

Bugs:
- [`calcTotal`](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM\test\orders.js#L5-L6) uses `i <= items.length` instead of `i < items.length`, so it reads `items[items.length]` as `undefined` and can throw on every non-empty array.
- [`averageItemPrice`](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM\test\orders.js#L18-L20) divides by `items.length` without handling an empty array, so empty input returns `NaN`.
- [`formatOrder`](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM\test\orders.js#L23-L26) inherits the `calcTotal` bug, so formatting an order can also crash.
